svg.aria-label: Lifecycle of a user sandbox. A request starts it from the image in 2.5 to 4.1 seconds. After 2 minutes idle, a Durable Object alarm snapshots it in 5.6 to 6.4 seconds and stops it in 0.1 seconds. Asleep, only the snapshot is kept, for 30 days. The next request restores it in 1.4 to 2.9 seconds. Every file on disk survives; memory, processes and connections do not.
